# meok-compliance-gateway
> MEOK Compliance Gateway — 13 unified governance frameworks as MCP tools. Streamable-HTTP gateway for EU AI Act, GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, NIS2, CRA, CSRD, ISO 42001, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST AI RMF, ESG, and supply-chain compliance. By MEOK AI Labs.

## Install
pip install agentaudit

## Auth
- Free tier: 100 calls/month, no API key needed
- Pro tier: unlimited, set MEOK_API_KEY env var
- Business tier: team features + x402 payments

## Tools

### quick_scan
Instant compliance check against 13 frameworks from a one-sentence system description. No API key required for free tier.
- `system` (str, required): One-sentence description of the AI system
- Returns: compliance_status, frameworks_impacted, top_3_obligations, deadline_days_remaining

### deadline_check
All regulatory deadlines across 13 frameworks with days remaining.
- Returns: List of milestone dates with days_remaining and applicable articles/articles

### framework_scan
Deep compliance assessment for a specific framework.
- `framework` (str, required): EU AI Act | GDPR | HIPAA | DORA | NIS2 | CRA | CSRD
- `system` (str, required): System description
- Returns: compliance_score, obligations, gaps, remediation_steps

### expert_list
List the expert models available for compliance tasks (6 compliance specialists).
- Returns: List of expert names and specializations

### audit_anchor
Create an auditable anchor point with SHA-256 hash chain.
- `data` (object, required): Data to anchor
- Returns: anchor_hash, timestamp, previous_anchor

### healthz
Gateway health check endpoint (no auth required).
- Returns: status, version, frameworks_loaded

## Endpoints

### streamable-HTTP
https://gateway.meok.ai/mcp

### A2A Agent Card
https://gateway.meok.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json

### MCP Registry Server Card
https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/meok-compliance-gateway/blob/main/.well-known/mcp-server

### Health
https://gateway.meok.ai/health

## Frameworks Available
- EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
- GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679)
- HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)
- DORA (Regulation (EU) 2024/1687)
- NIS2 (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
- CRA (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847)
- CSRD (Regulation (EU) 2024/2848)
- ISO 42001 (AI Management System)
- ISO 27001 (Information Security)
- SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria)
- NIST AI RMF
- ESG Disclosure
- Supply-chain Compliance

## x402 Payments
Some tools require USDC micro-payments via x402 protocol.
Set `X402_ENABLED=1` and `X402_PAY_TO` to enable.
